title: README
universal_lens: The typographic system is modeled as a finite-dimensional vector space over a discrete weight lattice. Glyph rendering constitutes a projection operator mapping abstract semantic intent to pixel-space manifolds, governed by strict orthogonality constraints between display and numerical subspaces.
gsi_mapping: Font weights act as categorical priors in a Bayesian hierarchical model of visual attention. Conformal prediction sets are constructed around glyph legibility thresholds, ensuring that numerical telemetry (JetBrains Mono) maintains invariant information density across varying viewport resolutions and environmental noise.
gse_mapping: Rendering state transitions are formalized as a deterministic automaton. The system shifts from CDN-dependent initialization to self-hosted production states upon asset verification. Situational reasoning dictates fallback mechanisms when proprietary brand font injections disrupt the baseline geometric grid.

primitives.name: Discrete Weight Projection Operator
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: w \in \{400, 500, 600, 700\} represents dimensionless stroke thickness scaling factors relative to an em-unit baseline.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes linear perceptual scaling of stroke width with respect to the integer weight parameter w.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs at w < 300 or w > 900 where glyph topology collapses into illegible noise or solid blocks.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI confidence intervals; heavier weights correspond to higher posterior certainty in data visualization layers.
layer2.telemetry: Average pixel density per character cell.

primitives.breakdown_regime: System failure if .woff2 binaries are corrupted during the transition from S=CDN to S=LOCAL.

primitives.name: Monospaced Telemetry Alignment Kernel
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \Delta x = constant defines the fixed horizontal advance width in CSS pixels for all glyphs in the mono subset.
primitives.assumptions: Strict monospacing ensures columnar alignment of quantitative sports metrics without layout shift.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Alignment breaks if variable-width ligatures are enabled within the JetBrains Mono configuration.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to GSI matrix alignment; guarantees that multi-variate statistical outputs maintain rigid structural integrity under dynamic updates.
layer2.telemetry: Column deviation variance in tabular data displays.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This typographic formalism inherits directly from Swiss International Style principles, which prioritized grid-based objectivity and sans-serif neutrality. Mathematically, it echoes the discretization methods of early digital typesetting (e.g., Knuth's METAFONT), where continuous curves were approximated by finite state machines. The shift to web fonts introduces network theory, borrowing from distributed systems literature to manage resource locality and caching strategies, ultimately converging on modern responsive design paradigms.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model two primary agents: the End User and the Infrastructure Engineer. The User seeks rapid cognitive parsing of sports metrics, requiring high contrast and stable numerical columns (favoring the Mono Invariant). The Engineer aims to minimize Time-to-Interactive (TTI) and ensure brand compliance. The system mediates these opposing goals by defaulting to fast CDN loads while providing a rigorous pathway for Engineers to inject proprietary assets, thereby satisfying both latency constraints and branding requirements without compromising the underlying data grid.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises if proprietary brand fonts violate the established weight lattice or monospacing assumptions. If a custom font lacks the required 400-700 range, the visual hierarchy collapses, triggering a cross-layer rejection. Additionally, leakage is prevented by strictly isolating the numerical mono layer from the proportional body layer; allowing variable-width glyphs in telemetry tables would cause catastrophic alignment drift, invalidating the conformal prediction bounds on data readability.
